Manage metrics

:::tip[Learn more]
The Bronto docs explain the platform concept behind this command: [docs.bronto.io/metrics/explore-metrics](https://docs.bronto.io/metrics/explore-metrics)
:::

```sh
bronto metrics <command> [flags]
```

#### Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`bronto metrics get`](/reference/commands/metrics/#bronto-metrics-get) | Get a metric by ID |
| [`bronto metrics list`](/reference/commands/metrics/#bronto-metrics-list) | List metrics |
| [`bronto metrics top-keys`](/reference/commands/metrics/#bronto-metrics-top-keys) | List the attribute keys seen on a metric |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

## bronto metrics get

Get a metric by ID

```sh
bronto metrics get <id> [flags]
```

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto metrics get <id>
```

## bronto metrics list

List metrics

```sh
bronto metrics list [flags]
```

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto metrics list
```

## bronto metrics top-keys

List the attribute keys seen on a metric

```sh
bronto metrics top-keys <metric> [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--since` |  | string | `1h` | lookback window (e.g. 15m, 1h, 1h30m) |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto metrics top-keys system.cpu.utilization --since 1h
```
